motion: Does the Kalam cosmological argument show that the universe began to exist, has a cause, and points to a personal creator?

sections.title: Causation, Nothingness, and an Eternal Material Alternative
sections.rationale: This opening section follows the exchange over the Kalam’s causal premise, the disanalogy between ordinary and cosmic beginnings, and the proposed alternative of an eternal material series. Its 16 percent weight reflects the structural role of causation without displacing the debate’s larger finitude and creator exchanges.

moveAssignments.rationale: This is the section’s load-bearing statement of the causal principle and its nothing-from-nothing basis, making it structurally indispensable to the opening exchange.
This move supplies the principal early challenge by separating observed material rearrangements from an absolute beginning of material reality.
This reply clarifies the intended substance-level principle and develops the claimed explanatory significance of a uniquely cosmic beginning.
This move advances the quantified-language objection and identifies the risk of presupposing the causal principle under discussion.
This is the section’s load-bearing contrary construction, using nothing-from-nothing reasoning to motivate a beginningless material causal series.

sections.title: Actual Infinities and Hilbert’s Hotel
sections.rationale: This section gathers the first finitude argument and the sustained Hilbert’s Hotel exchange over part-whole intuitions, inconsistent principles, checkout cases, and relative complements. Its 27 percent weight reflects the breadth and central structural role of the actual-infinite route and its detailed opposition.

moveAssignments.rationale: This move states the load-bearing inference from the alleged impossibility of actual infinities to a finite past and a beginning of the universe.
This move introduces Hilbert’s Hotel as the principal concrete illustration supporting the actual-infinite line developed throughout the section.
This is the first direct challenge to the hotel illustration, distinguishing acknowledged strangeness from metaphysical impossibility.
This move gives the section’s load-bearing contrary account of infinite cardinality and explains why finite part-whole intuitions may not transfer.
This reply defends the use of metaphysical intuition and frames rejection of concrete actual infinities as a resolution of the inconsistent triad.
This move presents an alternative resolution of the triad by varying the application of principles in finite and infinite contexts.
This move extends the hotel exchange through checkout cases in which equal infinite removals are associated with different remainders.
This reply supplies the formal relative-complement treatment of the checkout cases and keeps the mathematical dispute explicit.
This rejoinder preserves the concrete arithmetic objection after the relative-complement reformulation and closes the hotel exchange.

sections.title: Successive Addition, Countdown, and Descending-Series Paradoxes
sections.rationale: This section contains the second finitude argument and the extended dispute over whether a beginningless sequence can terminate in the present. It includes the conditional, explanatory-timing, and Grim Reaper exchanges. Its 27 percent weight parallels the independent actual-infinite route’s structural scope.

moveAssignments.rationale: This move states the section’s load-bearing successive-addition inference from temporal formation to a finite and beginning-bearing past.
This is the section’s load-bearing contrary distinction between reaching an endless count’s end and reaching the end of a beginningless countdown.
This reply develops the question of why a beginningless countdown terminates today rather than at an earlier past point.
This move supplies a structurally central conditional analysis distinguishing necessary elapsed time from sufficient conditions for completion.
This reply reframes the timing question through a restricted, case-specific explanatory principle rather than a universal principle.
This move answers the timing demand with local predecessor explanations and distinguishes them from an ultimate explanation.
This rejoinder argues that citing the preceding count does not identify the contextually relevant factor behind completion today.
This move adds the Grim Reaper construction as an independent descending-series illustration within the successive-addition topic.

sections.title: Metric Time and the Scope of Temporal Beginning
sections.rationale: This compact section isolates the late clarification about what the finitude arguments establish: a beginning of metric time and the possible status of a non-metric or amorphous temporal reality. Its 10 percent weight recognizes a consequential scope issue while preserving proportion with the fuller exchanges.

moveAssignments.rationale: This move presents the section’s load-bearing non-metric-past alternative even after the preceding finitude arguments are provisionally granted.
This material concession and qualification fixes the direct scope of the metric-time conclusion and records the reply concerning amorphous time.

sections.title: Impersonal Indeterminism and Timeless Personal Agency
sections.rationale: This final section organizes the creator inference, the impersonal indeterministic alternative, and the dispute over whether changeless consciousness is coherent. Its 20 percent weight reflects the separate and explicit personhood component of the motion while retaining the earlier causal and finitude emphasis.

moveAssignments.rationale: This move states the section’s load-bearing impersonal indeterministic alternative to a personal origin of the universe.
This move provides the principal creator inference by contrasting a personal explanation with an eternal impersonal mechanism.
This reply adds the consciousness-based objection to a changeless personal agent outside an evolving causal order.
This closing reply addresses the freeze illustration and preserves the debate’s explicit treatment of timeless personhood.

bridgeMappings.rationale: The motion-level pro route is retained across the causal premise, the two independent finitude lines, and the concluding personal-cause inference, with each cited move assigned to the corresponding chronological section.
The pro central bridge is concentrated in the actual-infinity section, where the core temporal inference and its Hilbert-style supporting exchanges are retained together.
The concrete-actual-infinity subsidiary bridge is represented by the hotel illustration, the intuition defense, and both stages of the checkout-remainder argument in section 02.
The successive-addition subsidiary bridge is retained in section 03 through its constructive statement, countdown timing arguments, explanatory rejoinders, and the Grim Reaper illustration.
The personal-cause subsidiary bridge is represented in section 05 by the reply favoring personal explanation and the later defense of coherent timeless personhood.

The motion-level con route spans challenges to cosmic causation, actual infinity, successive addition, the scope of metric beginning, and personal agency, with all retained evidence mapped to its assigned section.

The con central bridge is preserved through the beginningless-material alternative and the distinct infinite-past, non-metric-time, and impersonal-origin alternatives distributed chronologically across the plan.
The con Hilbert’s Hotel subsidiary bridge is fully located in section 02 through the strangeness distinction, cardinality analysis, linguistic resolution, and relative-complement formulation.
The con successive-addition subsidiary bridge is represented in section 03 by the count-up/countdown asymmetry, conditional analysis, and local predecessor explanation.
The con impersonal-origin subsidiary bridge is retained in section 05 through the indeterministic mechanism alternative and the related objection to changeless personal consciousness.
